description: Read immutable smoke proof history, optionally through one version. Results and mutations use the shared library; immutable observations cannot be rewritten.
embedding_description: Read immutable smoke proof history, optionally through one version. Uses the shared platform-smoke-proof/v1 producer with immutable Git input identities and explicit evidence. Current and historical results disclose reuse, skips, failures, unknown inputs and delegated commissioning; no caller-provided shell command is executed.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Read immutable smoke proof history, optionally through one version.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Read the returned evidence and explicit uncertainty before choosing the next action.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Read immutable smoke proof history, optionally through one version.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: Wrong immutable identity, unsafe paths, missing principal or stale expected_version are integrity failures. Unknown ancillary inputs produce advisories and disable unsafe reuse.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Use the current readback/version and the shared frozen-request producer. Retain original errors and history.
